method: fresh two-seed bounded exact-Hex8 joint bg_0..bg_5 + fg_0..fg_2 search per profile/lane; dependent banks rerun with candidate surfaces and controlled same-profile seed pairs; bounded evidence only
foreground_target: unit direction of the Light Mid-Depth mean Oklab a/b vector at chroma multipliers [1.2,1.0,0.8]; lane interpolation from shipped a/b; soft target with free L

full_system.bounds: surface shipped bytes ±3; foreground shipped bytes ±48; foreground Oklab L within shipped L ±0.06
full_system.objective: huge exact hard gates; transformed clarity/hierarchy and movement; then commanded warmth/chroma/soft target; terminal-coupled L repair

categorical.bounds: each shipped sRGB byte ±18, clipped to [0,255]
categorical.objective: hard release floors, then separation/clearance/contrast/corner evidence/movement

terminal.bounds: each shipped sRGB byte ±36 for 1200k-dark, otherwise ±16; clipped to [0,255]
terminal.objective: hard release floors and semantic hue recognition, then separation/clearance/contrast/corner evidence/movement

sequential.bounds: each shipped anchor sRGB byte ±10, clipped to [0,255]
